metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for the dev-build-deploy tools: get it right before the commit, not in CI.

plugins.name: commit-me
plugins.description: Checks Conventional Commit messages with commit-me before git commit runs.

plugins.name: reuse-me
plugins.description: Adds the right SPDX licence and copyright header to every file Claude writes (REUSE).

plugins.name: secret-me
plugins.description: Denies a Write, Edit, git commit or git push that would carry a secret, token or password (gitleaks with the org's rules; redacted findings).
